entities.name: High scores that can't be faked
entities.description: A score is listed only as the server's replay of the game computes it.
entities.behavior: The server issues the seed. The browser sends the game's recorded controls with a name, or null, for each player, and the Worker replays the whole game with the same engine from that seed. It claims the seed and stores, for each player who gave a name and scored, the score and wave the replay reached, with the number of players. Each entry comes back with its rank.
entities.outcome: Players can trust the table: a score cannot be typed in, edited or submitted twice, and in a two-player game each player's score is their own.
constraints: Games of up to two hours.
Names of up to 12 characters, cleaned the same way as in the browser.
One- and two-player games share one table; the Game column says which.

entities.name: Public scores page
entities.description: The table as a page of icelander.net.
entities.behavior: The best 25 scores are listed with the name, score, wave reached and whether it was a one- or two-player game, in the site's look, with inline styles so the strict content policy holds.
entities.outcome: Anyone can see the table without signing in or opening the game.
